changed:
The pydantic-ai driver emits action plans. In on, it offers plan output only for a bound run (allowed_capabilities set) whose budget allows more than one write. In off and shadow, the tools, outputs and prompt are byte-identical: four golden cases match the driver at a7d291f, and the base prompt golden and the captured recordings are unchanged.
- Plan steps map to the host-supplied ToolSpec connection. Unknown step keys are rejected, including any key naming a connection. The kernel resolves the exact binding.
- Step dependencies are typed lineage entries; a literal $lineage key is refused.
- A new authored replay fixture lives in tests/replays/erp-authored-plan-calls/. It is marked provenance 'authored', with no model digest, and a test enforces this. The replay suite replays both folders.
open_items: The plan recording is authored, not captured. No live model has been shown to produce a plan; that needs a qualified model run (evals, ADR 0010).
A malformed plan call becomes AskClarification, as an all-rejected response does today: a user round trip instead of a retry within the turn.
golden/off_model_request.json serialises pydantic-ai's ToolDefinition; a pydantic-ai upgrade needs it regenerated at a baseline commit.
Task 2c.8b: Codex C-1 to C-3, plus a plan step on an unbound connection raising FORBIDDEN out of start_run.

rulings.ruling: The authored recording is labelled as synthetic and kept in a separate folder from captured recordings (PR-29).
No DriverInput field was added; plan output is gated on allowed_capabilities and max_admitted_writes.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A field later if the budget source changes.

outside_repo.change: gate pg ran against e_agent_test in e-agent-ledger.
